#cloud-config
# ufw is deliberately NOT configured: Docker publishes container ports through iptables'
# nat table ahead of the filter chain

package_update: true
package_upgrade: true

packages:
  - curl
  - docker.io
  - docker-compose-v2
  - jq
  - wget
  - yq

groups:
  - docker

system_info:
  default_user:
    groups: [docker]

write_files:
  # writes the acme.json for the stage and live.
  # N.B.
  # - mount the desired folder as the /acme volume in traefik
  # - then update the resolver caServer value

  # LE staging: https://acme-staging-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory

          },
          "Certificates": []
        }
      }

  # gts staging: https://dv.acme-v02.test-api.pki.goog/directory
  - path: /opt/cirrus-acme-gts-staging/acme.json
    permissions: "0600"
    content: |
      {
        "myresolver": {
          "Account": {
            "Email": "andy.brown+cdvt1@technologyinbusiness.co.uk",
            "Registration": {
              "body": {
                "status": "valid",
                "contact": [
                  "mailto:andy.brown+cdvt1@technologyinbusiness.co.uk"
                ],
                "termsOfServiceAgreed": true,
                "externalAccountBinding": {
                  "payload": "eyJrdHkiOiJFQyIsImNydiI6IlAtMjU2IiwieCI6InEzN0I5bnpLbUdtckJUYjBRTTNXQUFOTFhyM1J0aFpvQm1RQUJuNU14aHciLCJ5IjoiQjRiRWY5MDI0NjMtMWZuWDdHR3hrbEFEcVpZT1lSUE1kNmlPUEJHOUxmYyJ9",
                  "protected": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsImtpZCI6IjFmODZkMDAzMDUwZGI5MTFhMzI4MzcxZWMxNDZlYTNlIiwidXJsIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9kdi5hY21lLXYwMi50ZXN0LWFwaS5wa2kuZ29vZy9uZXctYWNjb3VudCJ9",

  - path: /opt/cirrus/docker-compose.yml
    permissions: "0400"
    content: |
      services:
        traefik:
          image: traefik:v3.7
          ports:
            # http redirects to :80
            # https redirects to :443
            # traefik then redirects those to the http/https echo ports via dynamic discovery/routing config
            - "80:80"
            - "81:80"
            - "8080:80"
            - "9080:80"
            - "443:443"
            - "444:443"
            - "8443:443"
            - "9443:443"
          networks:
            - proxy
          volumes:
            - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
            - /opt/cirrus-acme-gts-staging:/acme
            #- /var/log:/var/log
          command:
            - --api.dashboard=false
            - --log.level=DEBUG
            #- --log.filepath=/var/log/traefik.log
            - --accesslog=true
            #- --accesslog.filepath=/var/log/traefik-access.log
            - --providers.docker.network=proxy
            - --providers.docker.exposedByDefault=false
            - --entrypoints.web.address=:80
            # no http->https redirect, although the effect is the same either way.
            #- --entrypoints.web.http.redirections.entrypoint.to=websecure
            #- --entryPoints.web.http.redirections.entrypoint.scheme=https
            - --entrypoints.websecure.address=:443
            - --entrypoints.websecure.asDefault=true
            - --entrypoints.websecure.http.tls.certresolver=myresolver
            # - --certificatesresolvers.myresolver.acme.eab=true
            # - --certificatesresolvers.myresolver.acme.eab.kid=
            # - --certificatesresolvers.myresolver.acme.eab.hmacEncoded=
            - --certificatesresolvers.myresolver.acme.email=andy.brown+cdvt@technologyinbusiness.co.uk
            - --certificatesresolvers.myresolver.acme.caServer=dv.acme-v02.test-api.pki.goog;
            - --certificatesresolvers.myresolver.acme.tlschallenge=true
            - --certificatesresolvers.myresolver.acme.storage=/acme/acme.json
          labels:
            - traefik.enable=true
            # TODO: hostname/cert for dashboard on internal network using DNS-01
            # - traefik.http.routers.mydashboard.rule=Host(`traefik.cdvt1.meteoapp.net`)
            # - traefik.http.routers.mydashboard.service=api@internal
            # - traefik.http.routers.mydashboard.middlewares=myauth
            # - traefik.http.middlewares.myauth.basicauth.users=test:$$apr1$$H6uskkkW$$IgXLP6ewTrSuBkTrqE8wj/

        echo:
          image: mendhak/http-https-echo
          restart: always
          # traefik discovers ports using dynamic/routing config
          networks:
            - proxy
          labels:
            - traefik.enable=true
            # one router per hostname. Each hostname gets its own cert.
            # One cert failure doesn't mean all fail
            - traefik.http.routers.echo-cdvt1.rule=Host(`public-cdvt1.test.cirrus.pw`)
            - traefik.http.routers.echo-cdvt1.entrypoints=web,websecure
            - traefik.http.routers.echo-cdvt1.service=echo
            - traefik.http.routers.echo-cdvt2.rule=Host(`split-cdvt1.test.cirrus.pw`)
            - traefik.http.routers.echo-cdvt2.entrypoints=web,websecure
            - traefik.http.routers.echo-cdvt2.service=echo
            # low-priority catchjall so health probes (use ip, not hostname)
            # - returns 200, not 404, priority 1 so other rules take priority.
            # - https probes get the default cert.
            - traefik.http.routers.echo-probe.rule=PathPrefix(`/`)
            - traefik.http.routers.echo-probe.priority=1
            - traefik.http.routers.echo-probe.entrypoints=web,websecure
            - traefik.http.routers.echo-probe.service=echo
            - traefik.http.services.echo.loadbalancer.server.port=8080

      networks:
        proxy:
          name: proxy

      # volumes:
      #   letsencrypt:
      #     name: letsencrypt

runcmd:
  # Enable at boot and start now, then bring the stack up detached.
  - systemctl enable --now docker
  - docker compose -f /opt/cirrus/docker-compose.yml up -d
